mission_05: Excellent! You have implemented DBSCAN, a powerful density-based approach that simultaneously clusters data and identifies outliers. Unlike distance-based methods, DBSCAN finds clusters of arbitrary shapes and does not require specifying the number of clusters in advance. Points that do not belong to any dense region are naturally classified as noise, making outlier detection a byproduct of the clustering process. The eps and min_samples parameters give you control over the density threshold, allowing you to tune sensitivity to different types of anomalies. DBSCAN is particularly valuable for spatial data, geographic analysis, and any dataset where clusters have irregular shapes. The automatic noise identification makes it an elegant choice for datasets where outlier detection and clustering are both needed.
